210本の見出しを、4本の線にする — Four Vectors from One Morning Paper

2026年9月10日の日経朝刊には210本の見出しが並ぶ。Instead of treating them as 210 separate stories, this essay reads them as four vectors: AI moving into real operations, geopolitical risk reaching prices, policy support revealing differences in household capacity, and competition shifting from single firms to networks.
